'''Manchucho''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Aleena/Legends|Aleena]] who was the [[King/Legends|King]] of [[Aleen/Legends|Aleen]].

==Biography==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Manchucho welcomed the [[Wolfpack/Legends|Wolfpack]] and asked the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] for relief efforts after the groundquakes. Commander [[Wolffe/Legends|Wolffe]] didn't understand his language so they needed [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] to translate his speaking.

Manchucho was a fair and intelligent king, who wanted a peaceful coexistence with the [[Kindalo/Legends|beings]] that lived beneath the surface of Aleen.
